TREATMENT OF HYPERLIPIDAEMIA
Non-drug Treatment
- Stop smoking
- Reduce weight
- Exercise moderately and regularly
- Water soluble fibre: oat, bran
Drug Treatment
- Atorvastatin
Notable Adverse Drug Reactions, Contraindications and Caution
- Caution in patients with history of liver disease, high alcohol intake
- Hypothyroidism should be adequately managed before starting treatment
with a statin
- Liver function tests mandatory before, and within 1 - month of starting
treatment; thereafter at intervals of 6 months for 1 year
- Statins may cause reversible myositis, headache, diarrhoea, nausea,
vomiting, constipation, flatulence, abdominal pain; insomnia
Prevention
- Dietary manipulation
- Early identification of individuals at risk
